summary: This clinical trial compares two different drug treatments for people who have chronic kidney disease and type 2 diabetes. Chronic kidney disease means the kidneys are damaged and have trouble filtering blood, while type 2 diabetes is a condition affecting how the body handles sugar. Researchers want to see how well the combination of dapagliflozin and finerenone works compared to dapagliflozin alone over eight weeks. The study is sponsored by Chittagong Medical College and aims to include 88 participants.
